summary.text: Kathleen Pratt is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 91, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is an at-large member of the Gettysburg Area School District school board, with a term ending in 2030.

paragraphs.text: Kathleen Pratt said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has an M.B.A., has worked as a business professor and ran a consulting practice focused on small business success.
She said she has lived in the community for 27 years, is serving a second term on the school board, and is a trustee of the Adams County Library System.
Pratt named sensible taxation and strong public schools among her priorities.
